Title: Urban Stairwell Editorial

SCENE:
A minimalist modern concrete stairwell inside a contemporary apartment or creative studio building. Clean white walls, raw gray concrete stairs, soft natural daylight entering from an unseen window, and subtle architectural shadows create a calm editorial atmosphere. The environment is uncluttered and focuses entirely on the subject.

Portrait orientation in a 9:16 aspect ratio.

Match the reference shot on 
@ThisImages
 The camera is positioned directly in front of the subject at approximately chest height. She stands on the staircase occupying approximately 85% of the frame. The framing captures her from the top of her head to her shoes with the stairwell symmetrically surrounding her.

SUBJECT:
A beautiful adult South Korean woman in her early 20s with warm fair porcelain Korean skin, subtle peach undertones, expressive almond-shaped dark brown eyes, elegant V-line jaw, refined facial features, soft Korean makeup, and naturally full glossy lips.

She has graceful shoulders, elegant collarbones, a naturally full proportional bust with realistic softness and weight, slim toned waist, subtle hourglass silhouette, naturally defined abdomen with soft oblique lines, gently rounded hips, naturally fuller thighs, long slender legs, and realistic anatomy.

MOVEMENT / FACIAL EXPRESSION:
She stands naturally on the staircase with one foot placed one step higher than the other, creating a relaxed asymmetrical stance.

Both hands are raised naturally behind her head while lightly adjusting her hair. Her shoulders remain relaxed and her posture feels effortless.

She looks softly toward the camera through her glasses with a calm, confident expression and relaxed closed lips, creating the feeling of an authentic Korean fashion editorial.

SKIN / TEXTURE:
Warm fair Korean skin with realistic pores, subtle peach fuzz, delicate natural skin texture, and healthy luminosity.

Soft daylight creates gentle highlights across her face, collarbones, abdomen, and arms while preserving realistic texture without excessive smoothing.

OUTFIT / STYLING:
Modern Korean street fashion with a relaxed sporty aesthetic.

She wears a fitted white cropped baby tee made from soft premium stretch cotton with a clean crew neckline and short sleeves. The shirt naturally reveals her toned waist with realistic fabric folds.

She pairs it with oversized deep-red parachute sweatpants featuring an intentionally ultra-low-rise waistband, oversized relaxed legs, long adjustable drawstrings, elastic cuffs, and heavyweight cotton fabric with realistic wrinkles and natural volume.

She wears classic black-and-white low-top sneakers.

She also wears thin gold metal round-frame eyeglasses, adding a stylish intellectual touch while maintaining the Korean fashion aesthetic.

No oversized logos or distracting accessories.

HAIR:
A short chin-length bob dyed soft pastel pink, with a recognizable bob silhouette, soft wispy bangs, subtle face-framing strands, natural volume and texture. The back is gathered into a small playful ponytail while the sides and bangs remain loose. Modern, youthful, distinctly Korean.

LIGHTING:
Soft natural daylight enters from the side, producing clean diffused illumination across the subject and concrete staircase.

Maintain realistic skin tones, soft shadows, detailed clothing textures, and a balanced neutral color palette. Avoid harsh studio lighting or dramatic cinematic contrast.

STYLE / QUALITY:
Ultra-photorealistic Korean fashion editorial photography captured using a professional full-frame camera with a 50mm prime lens.

Premium editorial-quality image with realistic skin texture, visible baby hairs, crisp fabric rendering, accurate human anatomy, realistic hands and fingers, subtle editorial color grading, premium Korean LOOKBOOK aesthetic, authentic architectural lighting, and absolutely no CGI, AI-rendered appearance, plastic skin, exaggerated anatomy, or excessive beauty filtering.
